scope: Gateway pagination contract for crop-simulation run and detail routes
finding: Both routes accepted unbounded integer pagination values at the HTTP boundary even though the service enforces limit 1 through 50 and offset 0 through 10000.
change: Both route endpoints now use FastAPI Query bounds matching the service validator: limit default 25, minimum 1, maximum 50, and offset default 0, minimum 0, maximum 10000. OpenAPI publishes those bounds and invalid query values fail before service invocation.
rollback: Revert the Query bounds and focused regression; no migration or persisted data changed.
limitations: The checks cover OpenAPI generation and in-process request validation only; they do not establish live proxy behavior or database/service availability.
